amended_scan_rule.comparison_plate_absence: candidate position must lie in >=1 astrometric scan footprint and no calibrated source may lie within 5 arcsec on any available comparison scan
amended_scan_rule.if_independent_plate_has_2plus_scans: counterpart must match across >=2 scans within 5 arcsec
amended_scan_rule.if_positive_plate_has_1_scan: single-scan detection retained; independent observatory confirmation is mandatory
amended_scan_rule.if_positive_plate_has_2plus_scans: candidate must match across >=2 scans within 5 arcsec

reason: v094 completed before any source query because it required >=2 scans on all three plates of every triplet. That requirement overgeneralized Busko's X/Y scanner-artifact control. Busko used dual scans where available on his selected Hamburg Schmidt material; APPLAUSE multiple scans are not universal. No source or candidate outcomes were inspected before this amendment.
source_quality_policy: No source-quality threshold is used for discovery in v094a. Raw calibrated catalogue coincidences are preserved first; Busko/SExtractor quality and morphology filtering is a later frozen stage. This avoids tuning quality thresholds after candidate outcomes.
